resources.string: Your account settings could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

Adds an account PIN to everything your recovery phrase alone could do: adding a device, deleting the account, changing this PIN. Someone who steals your phrase then still cannot add a device of their own.

Before you turn it on: there is no way back to Standard, and no reset. If you forget your account PIN, your account is lost for ever, even with your recovery phrase. Standard is a deliberate choice, not a lesser one: with it, your recovery phrase alone is always enough.

Your other devices that open everything are signed out, because their PINs would no longer match the account PIN. Each comes back with your recovery phrase and the account PIN. Devices with limited access, such as the browser extension, stay signed in.
This is your account PIN. It becomes this phone’s PIN too, and it is asked for separately, whenever your recovery phrase is used.
Adding a device, deleting the account and changing the account PIN need your account PIN as well as your recovery phrase.
There is no way back to Standard, and no reset. A forgotten account PIN ends the account.
Needs your recovery phrase, your current account PIN and the new one. Your recovery phrase alone can never replace a PIN that is set.
Your other devices that open everything are signed out, and each comes back with your recovery phrase and the new account PIN. The new PIN is also this phone’s PIN.
Your recovery phrase signs this change. This phone does not keep it, so type it here; it is forgotten as soon as the change is made.
This takes a moment. Keep Zekke open.
Paranoid mode is on. Your account PIN is now needed whenever your recovery phrase is used. It is also this phone’s PIN.
Your account PIN has changed. It is also this phone’s PIN now.
